Tuloy ang operasyon ng Q City Bus bukas, September 26, 2025 (Biyernes), upang maghatid ng libreng sakay sa mga commuter sa Quezon City. 

Narito ang intervals ng bus sa kada ruta para bukas:

Route 1 : QC Hall - Cubao (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 2 : QC Hall - Litex/IBP Road  (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 3: Welcome Rotonda - Aurora Katipunan (1 Hour Interval)
Route 4: QC Hall - Gen. Luis (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 5: QC Hall - Mindanao Ave. via Visayas Ave. (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 6: QC Hall - Gilmore (1 Hour Interval)
Route 7: QC Hall - C5/Ortigas Ave. Extension (1 Hour Interval)
Route 8: QC Hall - Muñoz  (30 Minutes Interval)

Magtatalaga ng traffic enforcers ang Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) para i-monitor at tulungan ang mga commuter na maaapektuhan ng masamang panahon.

Narito ang ruta ng biyahe ng Q City Bus: https://t.co/x7LtiZOceC

#QCityBus #LibrengSakay
